board: Mississippi State Board of Public Accountancy

cycle.note: Mississippi compliance years run July 1 – June 30 (report by August 1): 40 hours a year, up to 20 carried from last year. Each triennium (now July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2028) also needs 3 hours of Board-approved ethics and 1 hour of Mississippi law and regulations.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: 40 hours each July–June compliance year (30 Miss. Code R. 1-4.1). Up to 20 hours over last year's 40 carry forward.

requirements.label: Personal development
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 20 personal development hours count each year.

requirements.label: Mississippi ethics
requirements.note: 3 hours of Board-approved ethics and professional conduct each triennium (now July 2025 – June 2028). We count courses with "Mississippi" and "ethics" in the title.

requirements.label: Mississippi law & regulations
requirements.note: 1 hour on Mississippi Public Accountancy Law and Regulations each triennium. We count titles with "Mississippi" and "law" or "regulation".

newLicensee.note: No CPE is due in the compliance year you're licensed, and the ethics courses aren't due for the rest of that triennium.

licenseDateHint: Mississippi licenses renew every year. CPE years run July 1 – June 30 regardless.
issueDateHint: If you were licensed this compliance year (since July 1), no CPE is due until next July 1.
limitsNotTracked: Self-study must be NASBA QAS-approved; independent study isn't accepted.
Teaching: preparation credit up to twice the presentation time.
Personal development over 20 doesn't carry forward.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for at least 5 years after the end of the compliance year and triennium.
toVerify: Ethics titles: only Board-approved courses count (list on the Board site); the app matches "Mississippi" + "ethics".
